description:
Intel Renewed

WHAT DOES THIS MOD DO?
- Lets you decide what the intel screen shows. Hide whole kinds of entries, hide categories, hide single entries, drop the empty category buttons, and search the list.

Ever opened the intel screen with 200 mods and found your actual missions buried under Trait Suggestions, Simulator Updates and a lore tab with (0) in it that never goes away?
Cool, select one and press "Hide all like this". Every entry of that kind is gone, in this save and every other one.
Ever wished the category bar at the bottom had the eight buttons you use instead of forty?
Cool, open Customize and switch the rest off.

Nothing is deleted. Entries are only kept off the screen, and everything can be turned back on.
Requires LunaLib and LazyLib.

On the intel screen
A small strip sits in the top right corner of the map, next to the game's own STARSCAPE button.
Search: live, matches the entry title and its category names as you type.
Hide this entry: hides only the selected entry. Stored in that save.
Hide all like this: hides every entry of the same kind as the selected one (every Trait Suggestion, every Simulator Update). Stored per installation, so it holds in every save.
Show hidden: reveals the hidden entries while it is on, so you can select one and unhide it.
Customize: opens the window below.
Shift + right-click a row in the list hides that entry, Ctrl + right-click hides every entry of that kind. Works even when the strip is collapsed or out of the way.
The > button tucks the whole strip away into a small corner tab, and it steps aside on its own while an entry that draws its own big panel over the map is selected.

The Customize window
Categories: every category button with three choices. Show, No button (the button goes, the entries stay under their other categories) and Hide all (the button and everything filed under it are gone). New, Important, Accepted and Story are markers, not categories, so they can lose their button but never hide entries.
Kinds of entries: every kind of entry in your game, with the mod it comes from and how many there are, each with a Hidden toggle. A filter box narrows the list.
Hide empty categories (on by default): buttons with (0) in them disappear. New, Important and Major events always stay, as in the base game.
Restore everything puts it all back.

Popups
A hidden entry no longer shows its message popup in the bottom left corner, and does not play the sound either. Can be turned off in the LunaLib settings.

FAQ
Does it work with modded intel?
Yes. Kinds and categories are read from whatever is in your game, so it scales with your modlist.
Does hiding an entry delete it?
Never. The mod never touches the intel itself, so missions, bounties and mod events keep running. Hidden entries are only kept off the screen, the map and the popups, and Show hidden brings them back into view.
Where are my choices stored?
Hidden kinds and categories are stored once per installation, in saves/common/intel_renewed/. Single entries you hide are stored in that save.
Performance?
Negligible. It filters the list the game already builds. No extra scripts running in the background beyond a check for popups.
Can I add or remove it mid save?
Yes. It is UI only and safe to add or remove at any time.

AI use disclaimer
Some or all assets and code in this mod were created using AI tools:
Code: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5, Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Fable 5.1)
Text (readme and this post): Claude Code (Claude Opus 5, Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Fable 5.1)
Icon: Gemini

License
This mod is under the CC0 (Creative Commons Zero) License, allowing you to do whatever you want with the code, without giving any credit to anyone.
The UIFramework code by Starficz inside it keeps its own licence (LGPL-3.0).

Version log
0.3.0
Right-click hiding in the list: Shift + right-click hides one entry, Ctrl + right-click hides every entry of that kind. Works when the strip is collapsed or hidden behind an entry that draws its own panel.
0.2.0
The strip can be collapsed into a small corner tab, and it hides itself while a modded entry draws its own panel over the map, so nothing overlaps.
0.1.2
Mod icon, forum thread and version checker.
0.1.1
Fixed the Customize window opening empty with no way to close it. Un-hiding now brings entries straight back. Hiding the selected entry no longer confuses the list. Buttons renamed to "Hide this entry" / "Hide all like this", with tooltips.
0.1.0
First test release. Hide kinds, categories and single entries, hide empty category buttons, search box, popups of hidden entries silenced.

Mod that finally lets you hide annoying intel entries in your "Intel" tab.

Please report any potential bugs directly to me via discord DM
aiDescription: Adds a control strip to the intel screen allowing users to hide individual entries, entire categories, or all entries of a specific kind. It includes a search function and options to hide empty category buttons. Hidden entries are not deleted, only removed from view, and can be restored at any time.
